blocks.text: *Turn the weapons you find into the weapon you want.*
Every drop is a starting point

A weapon you find is rarely finished. What it arrives with depends on its **rarity**: higher-rarity weapons drop with more of their skills already filled in, a better chance of carrying an **Ultimate**, and more **Potential** to craft with. A common weapon might show up with a single skill; a legendary can drop nearly complete.

Every weapon has a **Potential** score — its personal, one-time crafting budget. You spend Potential to change its skills (**Add** and **Reforge**). Potential does **not** refill: once a weapon's Potential is gone, its skills are locked in for good — though you can still use, refine, and re-skin that weapon forever. A weapon with lots of Potential is simply a better canvas to invest in.

items: **Add** — fill an empty skill slot with a random skill from that weapon's pool.
**Reforge** — re-roll a weapon's normal skills, locking the ones you want to keep.
Your **Ultimate is never crafted** — it only ever comes from a drop. Hunting for the Ultimate you want is part of the chase, because **your Ultimate points at your build** (see *Skills*).

blocks.text: Separately, you can **refine** a weapon to raise its Attack (and any gear's Defense). Refining doesn't cost Potential — just materials.
Weapon Essence & recycling — nothing is wasted
The weapons you don't want aren't trash:

items: **Recycle** them into **Weapon Essence** — a powder that fuels every kind of weapon crafting. Better weapons recycle into more Essence.
Or keep one for its **look**: **Transmog** lets you wear any same-type weapon's appearance on your own (a Sword's look on a Sword), without changing its skills or stats.
**Refine** — Weapon Essence + a Refinement Stone + Gold.
